children: Open Text issued a conditional notice to redeem $1.0 billion of its 6.900% senior secured notes due 2027 and is exploring a potential senior secured notes offering.
Issued conditional notice to fully redeem $1.0B of 6.900% Senior Secured Notes due 2027, redemption date set for Oct 2, 2026.
Redemption is subject to conditions, including a financing condition requiring net offering proceeds or waiver.
Exploring a Rule 144A / Regulation S offering of senior secured notes to fund the redemption and related costs.
May use cash on hand for part of redemption if financing condition is met or waived; redeemed notes will be cancelled.
Seeking amendment to revolving credit agreement to extend maturity; amendment subject to definitive documentation and closing conditions.
